typeLong.native: Mobile or desktop app · public client

typeHint.web: Server-side app; a client secret is issued.
typeHint.spa: Runs in the browser; no secret, PKCE required.
typeHint.native: Mobile or desktop app; no secret, PKCE required.

status.expiring: {count, plural, one {Secret expires in # day} other {Secret expires in # days}}

sso.disabledToast: App disabled; open sessions end at their next refresh
sso.deleteBody: Signing in to this app with the org account stops right away. This cannot be undone.
sso.rotateBody: The old secret stops working immediately. You need to enter the new value in the app.
sso.emptyBody: Add an app people sign in to with their org account as an OpenID Connect client.
sso.skipConsent: Skip the consent screen for internal apps
sso.skipConsentHint: People are not asked "wants to access your profile"
sso.formHint: Redirect URIs must match exactly; no wildcards, http only for localhost.

fields.name: Name
fields.guestsHint: The org setting must be on too

uriProblem.fragment: The address cannot contain a # fragment.

sso.secretOnceTitle: The client secret is shown only now.

sso.publicClient: This is a public client: no secret, PKCE required.

idp.sectionHint: Sign in with SSO (OpenID Connect, SAML 2.0) and Active Directory / LDAP
idp.emptyBody: Connect Keycloak, Microsoft Entra ID, Google Workspace or Active Directory so people sign in with their org account.
idp.deleteBody: Linked accounts stay; from now on they sign in with a local password or another provider.
idp.mappingsHint: Groups are applied only when the account is created.
idp.mappingsHintSync: Groups are applied again on every sign-in and directory sync. The highest role wins; org owner can never come from a directory.
idp.noMappings: No mappings: new accounts get the default role.
idp.saveFirst: After saving, the addresses to give your IdP admin appear here.
idp.secretHint: Secret values are never shown again; they can only be replaced.

fields.name: Display name
fields.nameHint: Shown on the "Sign in with …" button
fields.enabledHint: When off, nobody can sign in this way
fields.domainsHint: People of these domains use this provider
fields.enforceSsoHint: Password sign-in is refused for these domains, except the org owner
fields.endSession: Sign out of the IdP too
fields.endSessionHint: Signing out of Crewhall also signs out of the IdP
fields.idpCertHint: PEM or base64; separate several with a blank line
fields.urlHint: ldaps://host:636 recommended; use StartTLS with ldap://
fields.userFilterHint: '{username}' is replaced with the typed name
fields.useMemberOfHint: When off, a separate group search runs
fields.caCertHint: Empty uses the system trust store
fields.jitHint: When off, only invited people can sign in
fields.defaultRoleHint: New accounts that match no mapping
fields.linkExisting: Link an account with the same e-mail
fields.linkExistingHint: Only when the IdP reports the e-mail as verified
fields.trustMfaHint: Local 2FA is skipped when the IdP reports MFA
fields.syncEnabledHint: People removed or disabled in the directory are suspended

adminHint.oidc: Create a client at the identity provider and register this redirect URI.
adminHint.saml: Create a SAML app at the IdP; enter the metadata URL or the values below.

idp.ldapAdminHint: Give the service account read access under the search base. Passwords are not stored in Crewhall; the directory is asked on every sign-in.

testHint.oidc: Fetches discovery and keys; nobody signs in. Unsaved values are tested too.
testHint.saml: Checks the metadata and certificate; nobody signs in.
testHint.ldap: Connects, binds with the service account and searches. Type a user name to see their groups and resulting role.

consent.title: {client} wants to sign you in with your {org} account

consent.footer: You sign in under your organization's security policy.
consent.deniedTitle: You don't have access to this app

backups.title: Backups
backups.subtitle: Nightly backup of the database and files; the same backups as the crewhall tool on the server
backups.unavailable: The server has no writable backup folder (CREWHALL_BACKUP_DIR). In a Docker Compose install the backups volume must be mounted.
backups.toolsOutdated: The backup tool is older than the database server: client {client}, server {server}. Backups cannot run with it; update the Crewhall image on the server.
backups.toolsMissing: The backup tool (pg_dump) cannot be run; the database server is {server}. Backups cannot run.
backups.enabledHint: Every night at the set time the database and files are backed up
backups.keepHint: Older ones and files only they use are deleted; manual backups stay
backups.diskHint: Unchanged files are stored once across backups
backups.restoreHint: Restoring is done on the server:

guest.endDateHint: Access closes by itself at the end of this day
guest.needsSpace: Guests see only the selected spaces; pick at least one.

compliance.title: Compliance
compliance.subtitle: Retention rules, legal hold, eDiscovery export and data loss prevention (DLP) rules
compliance.chatDaysHint: Messages older than this lose their content; held ones stay
compliance.auditDaysHint: At least a year; entries of people on hold stay
compliance.dlpHint: Checked in chat, board cards and comments. "Warn" asks for confirmation in chat and is only recorded elsewhere; "Block" does not send the content.
compliance.holdsHint: What the selected people wrote and the content of the spaces is never deleted by any cleanup until the hold ends; edited or deleted chat messages keep their original text.
compliance.releaseConfirm: Once released, the content follows the normal retention and trash rules again. Continue?
compliance.exportsHint: The content of the selected people and spaces is collected in one ZIP file; it can be downloaded for 7 days.

demo.accountsHint: Pick one and the password fills in. The data goes back to the sample at the top of every hour.
demo.banner: Live demo · the data resets in {minutes} min

stepup.passkeyFailed: The passkey could not verify you. Try again or use your password.
stepup.addPasskeyHint: Add a passkey to verify faster next time
stepup.offerBody: Use this device's lock instead of your password: a passkey is created and asked for directly at the next approval. Your password always stays an option.
stepup.offerFailed: The passkey could not be added. You can try again in My account › Security.
